standard_prerequisites.name: Weak etaleness is preserved by base change, so the fibre over a prime of the source is weakly etale over the residue field
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to the case of a weakly etale algebra over a field.

standard_prerequisites.name: A weakly etale algebra over a field is a filtered colimit of etale algebras over that field
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the weakly etale fibre into an object whose residue field extensions can be described.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale algebras over a field are filtered colimits of finite separable field extensions, so their residue field extensions at primes are of that form
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the conclusion that each residue field extension is a filtered colimit of finite separable extensions.

core_obligations: Fix a prime of the source and observe that the base changed algebra is weakly etale over the residue field, by the base change statement for weakly etale maps (proof lines 30561-30563).
Use the description of weakly etale algebras over a field as filtered colimits of etale algebras to write that fibre as such a colimit (proof lines 30564-30566).

For a prime of the target lying over the chosen one, identify the residue field extension as a filtered colimit of finite separable extensions, using the corresponding statement for etale algebras over a field (proof lines 30567-30572).
proof_roadmap: Base change to the residue field so the weak etaleness hypothesis becomes one over a field (proof lines 30561-30563).
Replace the fibre by a filtered colimit of etale algebras (proof lines 30564-30566).
Read the residue field extension off that colimit as a filtered colimit of finite separable extensions (proof lines 30567-30572).
